title: Peace is not decorative when doubt has been cut out from within.
summary: Guru links inward peace to an actual inner removal, not to external atmosphere alone.
takeaway: Real calm is carved, not staged.
lifeApplication: When you crave surface calm, ask what deeper confusion still needs truth instead.

source.shortMeaning: Doubt is removed from within as one walks in Guru's will.
source.lifeApplication: Let obedience go deeper than mood management.
